tasks.description: Ensure all storage, transport, and rendering layers declare and honor UTF-8 to prevent character corruption. This includes database storage, API transport, and frontend rendering.
acceptance_criteria: Given a UTF-8 encoded string, when stored and retrieved, then the string remains unchanged.
Given a non-UTF-8 encoded string, when stored and retrieved, then the string is converted to UTF-8.

tasks.description: Modify the display name field to accept any Unicode script, including Latin, Japanese, and Arabic. Ensure no characters are stripped or mangled on save or render.
acceptance_criteria: Given a display name with Latin characters, when saved and rendered, then the characters are displayed correctly.
Given a display name with Japanese characters, when saved and rendered, then the characters are displayed correctly.
Given a display name with Arabic characters, when saved and rendered, then the characters are displayed correctly.

tasks.description: Modify the layout, text alignment, and cursor behavior to switch to right-to-left when the profile language is Arabic.
acceptance_criteria: Given an Arabic profile language, when the profile page is rendered, then the layout is right-to-left.
Given mixed LTR/RTL content, when rendered, then the content is displayed with correct bidirectional ordering.

tasks.description: Modify the bio field to fully support emoji, including multi-codepoint sequences and ZWJ sequences.
acceptance_criteria: Given a bio with emoji, when saved and rendered, then the emoji are displayed correctly.
Given a bio with multi-codepoint sequences, when saved and rendered, then the sequences are displayed correctly.

tasks.description: Modify the truncation logic to operate on grapheme clusters, never on raw bytes or half a surrogate pair.
acceptance_criteria: Given a display name or bio exceeding its maximum length, when truncated, then the truncation operates on grapheme clusters.
Given a display name or bio with emoji, when truncated, then the emoji are not split in the middle.

tasks.description: Identify and fix any existing encoding issues in the storage, transport, and rendering layers to ensure UTF-8 encoding is honored.
acceptance_criteria: Given a UTF-8 encoded string, when stored and retrieved, then the string remains unchanged.
Given a non-UTF-8 encoded string, when stored and retrieved, then the string is converted to UTF-8.

tasks.description: Write integration tests to ensure the multilingual profile page features work as expected, including Unicode script support, RTL support, emoji support, and Unicode-safe truncation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a test suite, when run, then all tests pass.
Given a test case, when executed, then the expected result is achieved.
